videos.title: Kamil Jablonski's Way to Beat the King's Move: Out-Wait Him | Beat the King's Move #4
videos.summary:
Kamil Jablonski's answer to the king's move is to out-wait it: get into the flop-press position, push it down and learn to stay there. He shows how he trains that hold with a band: 30 seconds to a minute with 20-40 kg, shoulder behind, don't cross the line. Episode 4 of my series on many different ways to beat the king's move before my match against Bob Brown at EVW28.

EVW28 tickets and PPV: use code RAY for a discount.
